title: Banana, peanut butter & oatmeal cookies 🍪  hello from deep in my lute...
description: Banana, peanut butter & oatmeal cookies 🍪  hello from deep in my luteal phase 👋 satisfying my cravings while keeping my energy steady (and gut happy) with these delicious soft cookies. Even my husband who is not a banana fan has been asking for more!!🤝 You will need ⬇️  1 large ripe banana (or 1.5 small/ approx 120g) 60 g peanut butter 15 g maple syrup 100g g rolled oats 15 g ground flaxseed 40 g dark chocolate chips 30 g walnuts or pecans, finely chopped ¼ tsp fine sea salt  ½ tsp cinnamon Method Preheat oven to 175°C (fan 160°C). Line a baking tray. Mix banana, peanut butter and maple syrup until smooth. Stir in oats, flaxseed, salt and cinnamon. Fold through chocolate and nuts. Scoop into 10-12 mounds, gently flatten.Bake for 15 -18minutes, until just set but soft (depending on the size of your cookies). Cool fully on the tray before eating 🤌 #bananacookies #nutritionist #healthysnackideas
transcript: If you've got one spotted banana left you need to try these cookies. They're made with just a handful of ingredients that you probably already have at home. They come together in five minutes in bake in 15 and taste kind of like banana bread and a cookie had a baby. Perfect for those afternoons when you just need a little pick-me-up.
